method.browser: isolated scripted Firefox 153 and Chrome 153 sessions with touch, mouse, and keyboard input
limitations: Persona satisfaction is a task-completion proxy, not measured user sentiment.
No real phone, tablet, on-screen keyboard, VoiceOver, TalkBack, or other screen reader participated.
The standard browser accessibility tree does not enumerate internal egui canvas controls; app-spoken keyboard feedback is an alternative, not equivalent support.
CDP device-pixel-ratio overrides were excluded after producing an incorrect backing-store size; process-level high-DPI rendering was used instead.

Most full viewport and report paths ran on the immediately preceding frozen build; the final parser-only build repeated touch scrolling, Enter submission, negative-binomial input, and adversarial desktop parsing.

personas.label: First-time calculator user on a phone

evidence: Gross 767, Murphy yield 92.36%, and approximately 708 expected good dies remain distinct and readable at 320 through 412 CSS pixels.
A vertical W3C touch gesture starting on Active width scrolls the page while preserving 10 mm and does not open the editor.
The touch editor applies 10.25 with Enter, rejects 0.1 outside the displayed range, and preserves values on Cancel or Escape.
Negative binomial and alpha 2.5 are visible and editable at 320 pixels, producing 92.43% and approximately 709 good dies.
Portrait-landscape-portrait preserves state, and the map, five legend categories, and footer remain reachable without horizontal overflow.
The compact Report modal fits at 320 pixels and the JSON export path remains keyboard-operable.

personas.label: Domain expert on a touch tablet

evidence: 768x1024 and 820x1180 use the intended single column; 1180x820 uses two complete columns without right-edge clipping.
At 820x1180 a tap opens the numeric editor, while a swipe beginning on the same field scrolls without modifying diameter, dimensions, or D0.
The full disclosure row is a 44-point target, including its right-hand whitespace.
Alpha 2.5 gives exact yield 0.924274043305782 and expectation 708.9181912155348, matching an independent formula oracle.
The map, metadata, full A4 report, and JSON model metadata remain complete in tablet workflows.

personas.label: Mouse user entering precise desktop values

evidence: 1024x768 uses two columns without clipping and retains inline DragValue editing when no touch capability is present.
Changing Active width from 10 to 12.5 applies normally and changes Gross from 767 to 605.
NaN, infinity, and alphabetic text leave Active width at 10 and Gross at 767, with an accurate invalid-entry message.
Probe columns rejects 2.5 as not a finite whole number and preserves the prior value 4.

personas.label: Keyboard user on a constrained viewport

evidence: Report initially focuses Close, confines forward and reverse Tab to six modal actions, blocks background scrolling, and closes with Escape or backdrop activation.
After closing, focus returns to Report and Enter reopens the same modal.
Enter applies a valid value directly from the focused touch-safe numeric editor.
Ctrl+Alt+S toggles app-spoken feedback from the canvas, and the visible footer control exposes the same state.
The canvas has an application role, accessible name, keyboard instructions, and an always-visible spoken-feedback control inside the app.
Visual keyboard navigation, editing, disclosure, model selection, and report export paths complete without a pointer.
A speechSynthesis interception receives the enabled-state announcement and subsequent focused-widget output.
eframe 0.36 Web does not forward its internal AccessKit tree to browser accessibility APIs, so standard screen readers cannot enumerate every canvas control.
An independent rectangle-grid and Murphy oracle reproduces Gross 767, yield 0.92360878014683934, and exact expectation 708.4079343726257.
For alpha 2.5 and exposure 0.08, the independent formula reproduces yield 0.924274043305782 and expectation 708.9181912155348.
Phone and tablet touch swipes starting over numeric fields scroll the page without changing the model or opening an editor.
NaN, infinity, alphabetic text, out-of-range values, and fractional integer fields are rejected without modifying the prior valid result.
Every tested phone and tablet has canvas, body, and document dimensions equal to its CSS viewport and no horizontal overflow.
Keyboard focus and scroll input remain inside Report until explicit close, after which focus returns to the invoking action.

findings.summary: The negative-binomial alpha field was not visible at 320 CSS pixels
evidence: Alpha 2.5 is visible, editable, and independently verified on the final focused phone artifact.

findings.summary: The browser canvas had no labeled accessibility entry point or usable spoken-feedback path
evidence: The canvas now has a role, name, instructions, keyboard shortcut, and visible app-spoken control; the remaining control-level Web AX limitation is recorded separately.

findings.summary: The Report dialog did not confine keyboard focus
evidence: A real modal now traps forward and reverse Tab, freezes background scroll, closes with Escape or backdrop activation, and restores focus.

findings.summary: Phone labels and map metadata clipped inside the fixed canvas
evidence: Labels stack, metadata wraps, and the map contracts at 320 through 412 CSS pixels without horizontal overflow.

findings.summary: Tablet breakpoints wasted 1024 pixels and clipped the 1180-pixel layout
evidence: 1024 and 1180 landscape layouts now use two complete columns; tablet portrait layouts remain single-column.

findings.summary: Touch and disclosure targets were smaller than the intended comfort target
evidence: Interactive controls and disclosure rows now use a 44-point minimum height and full-row disclosure hit regions.

findings.summary: A touch swipe beginning on a numeric field changed the value instead of scrolling
evidence: Touch-safe click-only fields separate tap editing from page drag gestures on constrained and touch-capable viewports.

findings.summary: Desktop NaN input silently changed a dimension while claiming it was rejected
evidence: Field-aware finite parsers reject NaN, infinity, alphabetic text, and fractional probe counts without changing the model.

findings.summary: Standard Web accessibility APIs do not enumerate internal egui canvas controls
evidence: The accessible canvas entry point, complete keyboard path, and optional app-spoken output reduce the gap but are not equivalent to a semantic DOM or Web AccessKit adapter.

findings.summary: Scenario comparison has no retained baseline or explicit delta
evidence: Deterministic JSON supports manual comparison, but the application still does not retain two named scenarios side by side.
